bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to higher education; appropriating money for the state grant program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION.

$316,430,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $344,211,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Office of Higher Education for the state grant program under Minnesota Statutes, section 136A.121. If the appropriation in either fiscal year 2026 or fiscal year 2027 is insufficient, the appropriation for the other fiscal year is available for it. The base for this appropriation is $344,211,000 for fiscal year 2028 and each year thereafter.
additions: $316,430,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $344,211,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Office of Higher Education for the state grant program under Minnesota Statutes, section 136A.121. If the appropriation in either fiscal year 2026 or fiscal year 2027 is insufficient, the appropriation for the other fiscal year is available for it. The base for this appropriation is $344,211,000 for fiscal year 2028 and each year thereafter.
